We need to find mapped_rxn and template_id that when applied to target molecule (given in previous step) reproduces reaction: sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride. The available input data: from make_7_lvl2-apply_template-2 answer: [["Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1", "c1ccccc1N"]]. That seems to be precursors: product SMILES? Actually that answer likely is list of possible precursors from applying some template to the molecule. The molecule is target? The pair: product? The first SMILES is "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" which is a sulfonamide (aryl sulfonamide with a side chain). Second is "c1ccccc1N" an aniline. So the template likely breaks the S-N bond, giving sulfonyl chloride? Wait forward reaction: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. Retrosynthetic step: break S-N bond to give amine and sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl acid chloride). The precursor list includes aniline (amine) and the rest of molecule with sulfonyl attached to aromatic ring and a side chain (maybe sulfonyl chloride? Actually the first SMILES includes NS(=O)(=O)c2... So the sulfonamide still present. Wait the pair maybe product and precursor? The answer from apply_template-2: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_7_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below?" So they applied a template to the molecule (target) and got precursors list. The list includes two SMILES: the first is the product? Actually they ask "all possible precursors of applying the template". So the output is list of precursor sets. So each inner list is a set of precursors. Here they gave one set: ["Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1", "c1ccccc1N"]. That suggests the template when applied to the target molecule yields these two precursors. So the target molecule must be something else (maybe sulfonyl chloride attached to aromatic). The first precursor looks like the sulfonyl part still attached to aromatic and side chain, but still has NS(=O)(=O)?? Actually it still has N attached to S, so not broken. Hmm maybe the template is for sulfonyl chloride formation? Not sure.

We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that reproduces the reaction. So we need to find the template ID used in search. We have not yet searched. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate criteria: functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonamide"]? Not sure list. Let's get available functional groups.
